_about: Answers to HO:RA's address question (2026-11-12). transcripts: real conversations, the customer's messages in order (the first starts the request; every later one answers our question). Read by address_followup_test.go (rules: no follow-up is a search, a decline or a cancel, so each reaches the open request), by cmd/agenttest -address (the live parse of everything said never gives a placeholder title; the address model's guess, rules below) and by the liveeval replay TestLiveAddressFollowup (the whole router on the live models, the map stubbed). guesses: what the address model must propose from what was said — want: words the guess must contain; null: no guess (no single address, or no building number); or_null: ambiguous — the right guess or none both pass ("6 street" after "335 e 3 ave" may be 335 E 6th St or a building on 3rd Ave); place / near: the business named with no address and where to look for it (pilot 2026-11-17), words each field must contain; no_place: none may be read.
